name: Integer arithmetic
description: Adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing positive and negative whole numbers, respecting the order of operations.

name: Fractions
description: Simplifying fractions and adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing them using common denominators and reciprocals.

name: Algebraic expressions
description: Collecting like terms, expanding brackets and simplifying expressions that contain a variable.

name: Exponents
description: Using the laws of indices to multiply, divide and raise powers, including zero and negative exponents.

name: Linear equations
description: Solving equations of the form ax + b = c, including ones with brackets, fractions and the variable on both sides.

name: Factorization
description: Writing expressions as products by taking out common factors, factorising quadratics and using the difference of two squares.

name: Quadratic equations
description: Solving ax^2 + bx + c = 0 by factorising, completing the square or using the quadratic formula.
